papers.title: MIRT: Transformers for Truthful Generative Auctions with Whole-feed Permutation Externalities
papers.titleZh: MIRT: 基于Transformer的真实生成式拍卖与全信息流排列外部性
papers.abstract: Modern online platforms commonly rank ads and organic content separately before blending them into a feed displayed to the user, overlooking externalities: an item's click-through rate depends on its surrounding content, not only on its own position. Recent learning-based feed generation mechanisms model some of these cross-type interactions to globally optimize for the whole feed's welfare. However, these approaches either fix the ordering of organic content, or lack exact strategyproofness guarantees for bidders. To combat these shortfalls, we introduce the Maximal-in-Range Transformer (MIRT) mechanism class, which uses a transformer to generate a range of candidate feeds that jointly order ads and organic content, and selects the welfare-maximizing feed in the range. However, there is a tension: strategyproofness requires the generated range to be bid-independent, even though a candidate feed's welfare depends linearly on the bids. Our key technical contribution is a reinforcement learning approach that incorporates both candidate generation and bid-aware selection into training, enabling a bid-independent transformer to learn to generate high-welfare ranges by accounting for both individual feed quality and the collective quality of the range. Additionally, we bound the pseudo-dimension of the MIRT class under hard attention, showing that near-optimal expected welfare is learnable with sample complexity polynomial in the transformer size and only logarithmic in the range size. Empirically, MIRT outperforms the previous non-strategyproof state-of-the-art feed models while remaining exactly strategyproof. Our results show that transformer-based auctions can deliver externality-aware whole-feed optimization without sacrificing exact incentive compatibility, removing a major obstacle to their practical deployment.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 现代信息流平台通常分别排序广告与有机内容，忽视了周围内容对点击率的影响，即排列外部性。这导致整体福利受损，且联合排序可能破坏广告主的激励兼容性——广告主可能通过低报出价来维持有利的内容环境。现有方法要么忽略外部性，要么只能近似满足激励兼容，缺乏精确保障。本文旨在解决如何在考虑全信息流排列外部性的前提下，实现完全激励兼容的联合排序。
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 平台需为用户生成一个混合广告与有机内容的信息流。每个广告主提交出价，代表其点击收益，有机内容则带来平台侧福利。信息流中任一广告的点击率不仅取决于位置，还受前后内容影响。机制需从所有可能的混合序列中选择一个，并决定收费。关键约束是机制必须是最大值域（MIR）形式，即候选集不能依赖出价，以确保激励兼容。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 本文提出了MIRT机制类，首次实现了在考虑全信息流排列外部性下的精确激励兼容联合排序。MIRT使用Transformer生成一个出价无关的候选信息流集合，再从中选出报告福利最大的一个。实验证明，MIRT在社会福利上优于现有最先进方法，同时保持零激励违规，而对比方法的策略性误报可带来超过10%的效用提升。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: 作者采用强化学习训练一个编码器-解码器结构的Transformer，使其能生成高质量且多样化的候选信息流集合。训练目标是最大化在多个随机出价配置下集合中最优信息流的期望福利，从而隐式优化集合的整体质量。理论方面，通过分析硬注意力下Transformer的伪维度，证明了该机制的学习样本复杂度在变换器大小上为多项式，在集合大小上仅为对数级。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: MIRT依赖于离线训练和固定范围大小，实际部署需权衡范围大小与计算开销。其激励兼容性建立在MIR框架之上，但最优性受限于候选集的表达能力。尽管如此，该工作成功融合了深度学习的表达力与机制设计的形式化保障，为生成式拍卖提供了可信赖的架构。最值得阅读的是其将RL与MIR结合的设计思想及严谨的泛化边界分析。

papers.title: Parallelism or Concession? Concurrency-Aware Procurement Negotiation for Agentic Commerce
papers.titleZh: 并行还是让步？面向智能体商务的并发感知采购谈判
papers.abstract: Agentic buyers can cheaply fork a procurement task into many parallel negotiations, but concurrency is not free: every thread consumes resources, and simultaneous agreements create cancellation and commitment risk. We study a one-unit post-order sourcing problem with a single hard-deadline negotiation window, in which a planner jointly chooses the number of seller-facing negotiators and a common procurement price cap. The model combines a product-specific acceptance curve with fulfillment loss, per-thread cost, and excess-commitment cost. We establish three structural results. First, holding the per-thread acceptance target fixed, the marginal value of another negotiator decays geometrically, yielding a conditional concurrency threshold. Second, under a convex quantile curve, parallelism substitutes for concession: more concurrent negotiators imply a weakly lower per-thread acceptance target and price cap. Third, when prices are more dispersed, Agentic buyers benefit by searching harder for bargains, but suffer when they instead try to guarantee procurement by offering higher prices. We operationalize these results in the Concurrency-Aware Negotiation Optimizer (CANO), a deterministic optimizer that jointly determines the optimal negotiation concurrency and procurement price cap for an agentic procurement system. Across different analytic market configurations and extensive Monte Carlo, finite-data, non-Gaussian, and correlated-seller stress tests, CANO consistently outperforms common heuristic policies while validating the predicted structural properties.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 随着大语言模型智能体在商业场景中的应用，买家可低成本复制多个谈判代理并行与不同卖家协商，提升成交概率。但并行谈判消耗计算资源，且可能导致多个协议同时达成，带来履约冲突与取消成本。本文关注的核心问题是：在一次采购任务中，应启动多少个并行谈判线程，并设置怎样的统一价格上限，才能在履约成功率、成本与风险之间取得最优平衡。
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 模型考虑一个单位商品的采购任务，平台面对N个合格卖家，需决策启动m个并行谈判代理，并为所有代理设定相同的最终采购价格上限b。每个卖家以概率F(b)接受报价，谈判线程有固定成本，多个接受则产生超额承诺成本。目标是最大化期望利润，该目标综合了履约收益、失败损失、线程成本与超额承诺成本，形成一个联合优化问题。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 论文建立了三个结构性结论：第一，在固定单线程接受目标下，并行线程的边际价值呈几何衰减，存在一个并发阈值；第二，在凸分位数曲线下，并行性可替代价格让步，更多线程允许更低的价格上限；第三，价格分布越分散，积极搜寻低价更优，而试图通过高价确保履约则代价更高。基于此提出了Cano优化器。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: 作者通过构建期望利润函数，分离出履约、成本与超额承诺三项经济要素，进而分析其对并发数与价格上限的敏感性。利用边际分析与包络定理，证明了并发阈值的存在性、并行与让步的替代关系，以及价格离散度影响的符号反转现象。数值实现采用全局扫描结合黄金分割优化，确保稳健求解。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 模型假设卖家独立同分布，忽略了潜在相关性冲击，且聚焦于单一商品与固定时间窗口。尽管如此，其核心价值在于提供了一个可审计、可解释的经济控制层设计原则。最值得阅读的是其对并行与让步权衡的理论刻画，以及Cano作为外层控制器与语言策略解耦的设计思想。

papers.title: The Hardness of Dominant Strategy Mechanism Design, Revisited
papers.titleZh: 主导策略机制设计的难度，再探
papers.abstract: We study the communication complexity of \emph{dominant-strategy incentive-compatible} (DSIC) mechanisms for combinatorial auctions. For $γ\in [\log m, m]$, let $\mathsf{DSIC_{GEN}}(m, γ)$, $\mathsf{DSIC_{XOS}}(m, γ)$, and $\mathsf{DSIC_{GS}}(m, γ)$ denote the best approximation ratio attainable by a deterministic, individually rational, no-negative-transfers, DSIC mechanism using at most $2^γ$ communication over $m$ items, for general monotone, XOS, and gross substitutes (GS) valuations, respectively. We give a unified proof that shows $\mathsf{DSIC_{GEN}}(m, γ) = Ω(m/γ)$, $\mathsf{DSIC_{XOS}}(m, γ) = Ω((m/γ)^{1/5})$, and $\mathsf{DSIC_{GS}}(m, γ) = Ω((m/γ)^{1/7})$. The GS lower bound answers an open question of~\cite{DobzinskiRV22}: although poly-communication welfare maximization for GS valuations admits a poly-communication deterministic truthful mechanism via VCG, no good approximation is possible in poly-communication for deterministic DSIC mechanisms. Additionally, the general lower bound establishes that $\mathsf{DSIC_{GEN}}(m, γ) = Θ(m/γ)$ due to the deterministic DSIC $O(m/γ)$-approximation of~\cite{QiuW24}. We also obtain several results in the two-bidder setting. We show that attaining a $1.0001$-approximation for two weighted matroid-rank valuations (a subclass of GS) with a universally DSIC mechanism requires exponential communication. On the other hand, we give a poly-communication $(1+\sqrt{5})/2 \approx 1.618$-approximation for two submodular bidders using a universally DSIC mechanism. Prior to this work, it was not known whether even a poly-communication universally truthful mechanism could beat a $2$-approximation for two submodular valuations, nor whether a poly-communication universally DSIC mechanism could beat a $2$-approximation for two weighted matroid rank valuations.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 本文探讨为何在组合拍卖中，要求机制满足更强的激励兼容性（主导策略）会显著增加设计难度。已知在较弱的均衡意义下可高效近似社会福利，但若要求每个投标者无论他人行为如何都愿诚实报价，则性能可能急剧下降。文章聚焦于通信复杂度视角，追问这种效率损失是否本质存在。
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 模型考虑多个投标者竞拍m件物品，各自持有私有估值函数，目标是最大化社会福利。机制需通过通信协议决定分配与支付。作者对比了truthful与更严格的DSIC机制，后者要求投标者的诚实策略构成主导策略。研究设定关注确定性、个体理性、无负转移的DSIC机制，并量化其在有限通信下的近似能力。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 论文证明了对于GS、XOS及一般单调估值类，任何多项式通信的确定性DSIC机制都无法实现常数近似比，首次建立了超常数下界。特别是解决了DRV22提出的开放问题：即使GS估值存在高效truthful机制，也无法在DSIC下实现良好近似。此外，在双投标者情形下，展示了普遍DSIC机制的能力边界与可能性。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: 作者采用统一框架，将良好的DSIC机制转化为同步算法，并利用硬实例分布上的同步通信下界进行归约。关键技术是‘放大’估值差异并结合条件策略论证，迫使机制暴露估值信息。通过构造基于拟阵秩的估值族与精细参数调控，实现了对不同估值类的紧致分析。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 结果依赖特定人工构造的估值分布，未必反映实际场景强度。证明路径复杂，机制不可直接实现。但其价值在于揭示了激励强度与计算效率的根本张力，提供了强有力的归约方法论。最值得细读的是主定理的统一证明结构与双投标者情形下的正反结果对比。

papers.title: The Complexity of Computing Nash Equilibria in Colonel Blotto Games
papers.titleZh: 计算Colonel Blotto游戏中纳什均衡的复杂性
papers.abstract: We study the complexity of Nash equilibrium computation in discrete Colonel Blotto games. For two-player general-sum Colonel Blotto with monotonic piecewise-constant battlefield payoffs, we show that computing an inverse-polynomial approximate Nash equilibrium is PPAD-hard, even with only two battlefields and a constant number of pieces per battlefield, thereby resolving an open question of [KPF+25]. Allowing more battlefields, the hardness persists when every battlefield payoff is $2$-piecewise constant with respect to either player's allocation. A general PPAD-membership theorem for multiplayer Blotto with arbitrary local reward functions then implies PPAD-completeness for both hardness results. Motivated by fixed-rank bimatrix games, we then identify a tractable frontier within two-player general-sum Colonel Blotto. If the social payoff has rank-$r$ structure, then, for every fixed $r$, an $\varepsilon$-Nash equilibrium can be computed in time polynomial in $B_1,B_2,k$, and $1/\varepsilon$. Thus constant-rank two-player Colonel Blotto remains tractable despite its exponentially large pure strategy spaces. Finally, we study multiplayer winner-takes-all Colonel Blotto with player-specific battlefield values and uncover a sharp tie-breaking frontier. If every highest bidder receives her full battlefield value, an exact pure Nash equilibrium can be computed in polynomial time for arbitrary binary-encoded budgets. In contrast, under ordinary equal splitting among highest bidders, we prove that computing an inverse-polynomial-accuracy Nash equilibrium is PPAD-hard even with only five players. This resolves an open question posed in concurrent work by Bichler and Ghosh [BG26], who established PPAD-hardness in the same player-specific equal-splitting setting when the number of players grows with the instance and asked whether hardness persists for a constant number of players.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 为什么计算Blotto游戏中的纳什均衡如此困难？尽管经典零和版本已被高效求解，一般和版本的计算复杂性仍不清楚。本文聚焦于离散Blotto游戏中一般和设定下的均衡计算难题，探究局部收益结构（如单调分段常数）是否足以导致计算困难，填补了从易到难的理论断层。
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 作者研究多人离散Blotto模型：玩家将预算分配至战场，总效用为各战场收益之和。特别关注两人一般和及多人胜者全得（WTA）变体，其中战场收益可为单调分段常数或依赖于平局规则。策略空间指数级增长，均衡计算归约为寻找满足激励相容的混合策略分布。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 论文建立了清晰的复杂性边界：即使仅两个战场且收益为4段常数，近似纳什均衡计算也是PPAD-完全的；而在固定秩的社会收益结构下，存在多项式时间近似算法。更发现平局规则决定多人WTA的难度——全奖励允许多项式时间纯均衡，而均分则使五人情形下变为PPAD-完全。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: 作者通过从稀疏双矩阵博弈出发的规约证明硬度，精心设计战场收益以编码源博弈支付并强制策略集中在有效动作上。对于正向结果，利用可行流表示与边际方向分解，将均衡计算转化为低秩二次优化问题，并应用Vavasis的固定秩近似算法实现高效求解。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 结果依赖特定收益结构或平局规则，可能限制在更广泛情境下的直接适用性。然而，其对‘交互秩’与‘平局机制’作为复杂性分水岭的揭示极具洞察力。最值得阅读的是其紧致的规约构造、低秩均衡的算法框架，以及关于平局规则影响的锐利发现。

papers.title: Incentive Alignment in Online Experimentation
papers.titleZh: 在线实验中的激励对齐
papers.abstract: Evaluating the causal effect of new features is a central goal for online platforms. While recent literature addresses limited testing traffic via centralized portfolio optimization, this perspective abstracts away a critical institutional reality: experimentation is operationally decentralized. The experimenters who develop new features also dictate which hypotheses to test, and they are typically rewarded based on empirical average treatment effects that are prone to upward bias. Left unchecked, this principal-agent conflict can severely erode platform value, a structural failure that conventional centralized levers, such as significance thresholds and traffic budgets, cannot resolve. By reframing experimentation as an incentive design problem, we demonstrate that two practical mechanisms, sample splitting and shrinkage, can effectively bridge this gap. Sample splitting aligns incentives perfectly at a bounded traffic cost, while shrinkage consumes no additional traffic and guarantees that interventions with negative expected effects are strictly unprofitable to field.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 在线平台广泛依赖A/B测试评估新功能，但实验者往往基于显著的正向结果获得奖励，这导致他们倾向于测试统计波动大的干预，而非真正有益于平台的功能。这种激励错位源于去中心化的实验决策结构：开发功能的人自主决定测试哪些假设。尽管现有研究将实验流量视为集中优化的投资组合问题，却忽略了个体实验者的自利行为可能彻底破坏平台价值。
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 模型考虑一个实验者在固定预算下分配测试资源给多个候选干预。每个干预有真实效应和方差，测试后得到带噪声的效果估计。平台仅从真实效应为正的上线干预中获益，而实验者则根据显著正向结果及其估计值获得奖励。关键设定在于实验者自行决定预算分配，形成一个委托-代理问题：实验者追求自身奖励最大化，可能导致平台价值为零。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 论文证明，无论设置多严格的显著性阈值或预算限制，都无法阻止战略性的实验者使平台期望价值降为零。作为解决方案，提出两种机制：样本分割通过预留独立评估样本来消除估计偏差，实现激励完全对齐；收缩机制则通过对估计值扣除方差惩罚，确保负效应干预无利可图。前者在有界成本下实现完美对齐，后者不消耗额外流量并提供常数近似保证。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: 作者通过构建预算分配博弈来刻画激励错位，并利用截断高斯分布的性质分析实验者的最优策略。样本分割的证明依赖于选择样本与评估样本的独立性，从而分离决策与奖励计算。收缩机制的设计基于对零效应干预期望奖励的精确补偿，技术核心是通过调整回报函数本身而非估计过程来重塑激励。证明中运用了标准正态累积分布与密度函数的分析性质。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 模型假设实验者拥有真实先验且仅考虑单次静态分配，未涵盖学习动态或多轮反馈。机制虽实用，但样本分割需牺牲部分统计功效，收缩依赖精确的方差知识。然而，论文的价值在于将因果推断问题重新框定为机制设计挑战，提供了可直接落地的激励校正方案。最值得读的是其经济视角下的样本分割新解与收缩机制的严格保障，对工业级实验系统具有指导意义。

papers.title: CLIFT: Conformal Self-Verification for Web Agent Training and Test-Time Scaling
papers.titleZh: CLIFT: 用于网页智能体训练与测试时扩展的共形自验证
papers.abstract: Open-source web agents are now strong enough to execute realistic browser tasks, but training them with reinforcement learning still depends on weak supervision: binary task success is too sparse for credit assignment, while frontier-language-model judges are too expensive to call at every step and cannot be assumed available at deployment. We introduce CLIFT, a training and test-time scaling method built around conformal self-verification. During training, the agent answers natural-language verification questions about its own rollouts; a Compositional Conformal Certifier keeps only question signals whose URL-conditional evidence agrees with a training-time judge, assigns signed trust weights through polarity-aware lift, and blends the resulting verifier score into per-step rewards in a way that never subtracts from the judge baseline. At test time, the same certified bank is frozen and reused as structured evidence for Conformal Trajectory Selection (CTS): the agent samples a greedy rollout and one or more diverse retries, the self-verifier summarises each URL trace, and a conservative majority-vote rule chooses whether to swap away from the current incumbent without calling any external judge. This single mechanism supports three settings. On WebArena Infinity, CLIFT achieves state-of-the-art performance among open-source web agents. On VisualWebArena, a bank trained with the open model transfers to GPT-5.5 at test time and reaches state-of-the-art performance under the canonical harness. On Online Mind2Web, without training an agent on the benchmark, translating the certified question bank improves a live-web agent in zero-shot evaluation. Together these results position conformal self-verification as a way to turn costly judge feedback into a reusable training signal and a judge-free test-time scaling signal.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 当前开源网页智能体虽能执行真实浏览器任务，但依赖稀疏的二元成功信号或昂贵的前沿大模型评判器进行训练，导致信用分配困难且无法在部署时持续使用。本文聚焦于如何将高成本的评判反馈转化为可重复利用的训练信号，并在无外部评判的情况下实现测试时扩展，解决训练与推理之间信号不一致的问题。
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 研究设定在一个基于强化学习的网页操作任务中，智能体需完成真实网站上的复杂指令。输入为任务目标和网页状态，输出为浏览器动作序列。通过程序化验证器或大模型评判轨迹质量。作者在WebArena、VisualWebArena和Online Mind2Web三个基准上评估，分别测试训练增强、跨模型迁移和零样本测试时选择能力。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 论文提出CLIFT方法，首次将共形自验证机制同时用于训练奖励增强和测试时轨迹选择。结果显示其在多个基准上达到开源智能体最优性能，并证明训练中提取的验证知识可迁移到更强闭源模型甚至不同领域，在无需微调策略的情况下提升成功率，揭示了可重用验证信号的价值。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: 核心是构建一个经共形认证的自然语言验证问题库，每个问题关联URL范围、极性和可信权重。训练时，这些问题的答案被整合为非负的逐步奖励，辅助信用分配；测试时，冻结的问题库存用于比较不同轨迹的证据强度，通过保守多数投票决定是否替换当前轨迹，确保选择安全可靠。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 方法依赖初始评判器的质量，若其存在系统性偏见则难以察觉；且在噪声较大的真实网页环境中部分问题无法通过认证。尽管如此，该文最值得阅读的是其系统设计思想——如何将评判反馈提炼为可审计、可迁移的中间表示，这对构建可持续进化的智能体系统具有启发意义。

papers.title: Base Models Can Reason By Taking a Cue From Training Data
papers.titleZh: 基础模型通过从训练数据中获取线索进行推理
papers.abstract: In this paper, we study how training data creates associations between the tokens at the start of a base model's response and the reasoning behavior that follows. First, we demonstrate that fixing particular starting token cues makes a base model's performance competitive with that of its reinforcement learning (RL)-trained counterparts on math and coding. For instance, the cue ".\n\nOkay" raises Olmo-3-7B's MATH-500 pass@1 accuracy from 42% to 78%, while "Alright," raises Qwen3-14B's from 72% to 87%. Second, RL makes these cues more likely, while fixing them recovers much of its performance gain over the base model. Third, we trace the reasoning effects of token cues to the training data. We perform causal data interventions to turn an arbitrary word, such as "chicken", into an effective reasoning cue, or remove an existing cue's effect. A similar edit makes the prompt instruction "Think duck duck goose" as effective as "Think step by step" at eliciting reasoning. We also find that the hidden state representations induced by different cues correlate with different document types from the training set. Finally, we extend our study of token cues with a case study in language model safety, finding that different cues elicit distinct refusal and compliance behaviors that correspond to different types of training data.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 为什么基础语言模型看似不会推理，但稍加引导就能表现优异？本文质疑了‘推理能力必须通过强化学习（RL）训练获得’的普遍假设，指出基础模型可能已具备推理潜力，只是缺乏触发它的正确启动信号。关键问题是：这些行为是如何被训练数据中的模式所塑造的？
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 研究聚焦于基础模型在数学与编程任务上的响应起始标记（token cue），观察仅固定前几个输出token如何影响后续推理行为。实验采用Olmo和Qwen系列模型，在MATH、GSM8K等基准上对比无提示、人工预填线索及RL微调后的表现，并通过修改训练数据来检验因果关系。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 论文发现简单的起始标记（如‘\n\nOkay’）即可使基础模型达到甚至超过RL模型的推理性能。更重要的是，通过编辑训练数据可任意创建或消除此类线索的有效性，证明其效果源于数据中的统计关联而非语义理解。这揭示了RL提升的部分本质是放大已有行为倾向。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: 作者利用beam search结合答案一致性筛选有效线索，随后通过干预训练数据（如将‘okay’替换为‘chicken’）重新训练模型，验证线索效果的可塑性。同时分析隐藏状态迁移路径，发现不同线索会激活与特定训练文本类型相关的表示轨迹，从而导向不同行为模式。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 结论依赖特定模型与合成数据比例较高的训练集，未必普适于所有架构。此外，仅靠线索无法完全复现复杂对齐行为。最值得阅读的是其将训练数据视为条件反射建立过程的视角，以及通过数据编辑揭示模型行为根源的因果分析方法。

papers.title: Aligning Multimodal Patient Evidence with Biomedical Knowledge Graphs for Clinical LLMs
papers.titleZh: 将多模态患者证据与生物医学知识图谱对齐以支持临床大语言模型
papers.abstract: Clinical questions often depend on linking a patient's multimodal evidence to external biomedical knowledge, yet existing predictive systems rarely represent such links explicitly, so they can neither be traced to their evidence sources nor removed to measure their contributions. We present MM-KG (Multimodal Knowledge Graph), which represents heterogeneous, multimodal patient observations and biomedical concepts as separate layers in one typed graph, joined by explicit alignment edges. First, modality-specific harmonizers convert EHR text, imaging, genomic, and biospecimen data into typed observations mapped to UMLS concepts, which a route-prioritized aligner links to a biomedical knowledge graph. Query-conditioned retrieval then selects a compact subgraph for downstream use by a large language model or a graph neural network. We build MM-KGs for MIMIC-IV and ADNI, and evaluate them with a 2x2 design that separates patient evidence, biomedical knowledge, and their interaction. On questions that require both sources, neither source alone performs far above chance, whereas their combination yields a drug-controlled AUROC interaction of +0.194 on MIMIC and +0.299 on ADNI. On held-out five-candidate ranking, MM-KG outperforms MindMap by +0.131 Hits@1 and leads an adapted GraphCare on the items that require consulting the patient, and deleting the single answer-bearing relation from the retrieved packet returns Hits@1 to the no-knowledge baseline. Finally, query-conditioned retrieval reaches 0.731 AUROC with 6.8x less context than the strongest generic policy, whereas static knowledge graph context gives no consistent gain on ordinary outcome prediction. Knowledge graphs thus benefit clinical LLMs not as background context but as explicit links between multimodal patient evidence and the relation a question requires, and MM-KG makes these links retrievable, traceable, and testable.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 现有临床预测模型通常将多模态患者数据融合为单一向量，导致原始观察与外部知识间的连接不可追溯。这使得模型无法解释其决策依据，也无法评估特定证据的贡献。本文聚焦于需要同时依赖患者个体证据（如检验值）和通用医学知识（如药物禁忌）才能回答的问题，指出当前方法因缺乏显式对齐机制而在推理透明性和准确性上存在根本缺陷。
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 研究构建了MM-KG框架，将患者的电子病历、影像、基因等多模态数据转化为带有溯源信息的标准化观测节点，并通过明确的对齐边连接至生物医学知识图谱PrimeKG。在问答时，系统基于问题动态检索一个紧凑子图，包含相关患者发现及其关联的知识关系，供下游大语言模型或图神经网络使用。评估涵盖MIMIC-IV和ADNI两个独立队列，采用因子设计分离患者证据、知识图谱及二者交互的影响。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 论文核心贡献在于实现了患者证据与医学知识间可追溯、可测试的显式对齐。实验表明，在需联合两类信息的问题上，单独使用任一来源性能接近随机，而结合后AUC提升显著（MIMIC+0.194，ADNI+0.299）。删除关键对齐边会使性能回落至基线，证明其必要性。此外，所提查询条件检索策略以6.8倍更少上下文达到更高准确率，验证了效率优势。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: 方法的关键是保持实例层与本体层分离，通过路由优先的对齐器建立可独立操作的ALIGNS_TO边。每个观测保留其来源和时间戳，确保可审计性。查询条件检索仅提取与问题相关的患者邻域和候选实体的关系包，形成紧凑推理路径。这种设计使消融实验成为可能，从而直接验证特定对齐边的作用，而非依赖间接推测。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 尽管结果有力，但结论依赖于特定知识图谱（PrimeKG）的正确性，行为验证显示模型会同等遵循被证实和被违背的医学关系。静态知识图谱对常规预后无增益，说明其价值局限于需显式推理的任务。最值得阅读的是其系统设计理念、因子实验设置和对齐可测试性的论证，这对构建可信临床AI具有指导意义。

papers.title: How Sparse Probability Maps Shape Mixture-of-Experts Routing
papers.titleZh: 稀疏概率映射如何塑造专家混合模型的路由机制
papers.abstract: Mixture-of-experts (MoE) routers typically apply softmax to the router scores and keep the top-K experts, making every token use exactly K experts. Sparsity-inducing probability maps such as sparsemax, alpha-entmax and normmax can adaptively assign exact zeros to selected experts, and therefore appear to offer token-dependent expert participation, even when using the same top-K machinery. In this work, we study whether and how this sparsity survives training. We train matched 300M and 1B top-2 MoE language models with softmax, 1.5-entmax, sparsemax and 2-normmax, and find that the maps behave very differently once trained: at 1B, entmax discards 30% less probability mass than softmax while almost never dropping a selected expert, sparsemax retains the most mass, and normmax routes 21% of tokens to a single expert. These outcomes are not properties of the maps alone. Each map drops a selected expert only when the gap between the two largest scores reaches a fixed threshold, and the trained routers differ in the score distribution they learn: the entmax router learns scores with roughly half the spread of softmax's, which keeps its top-2 gaps below its threshold, while sparsemax and normmax, which share the same threshold, learn different gap distributions and hence different participation. Routers thus co-adapt their scores to the map, and a map's capacity to produce zeros does not by itself determine expert participation. While none of the sparse maps improves validation loss over softmax, they make the trained models far less sensitive to selecting more experts at inference: sparsemax trained with K=2 loses 0.02 nats when run with K=8, where softmax loses 0.58. Our results indicate that adaptive MoE routing has to be designed around the joint behavior of the probability map and the learned scores, rather than around the map alone.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 专家混合（MoE）模型通过动态激活部分专家提升效率，但传统基于softmax的路由器强制每个token使用固定数量的专家，导致资源浪费和灵活性不足。尽管稀疏概率映射如sparsemax、entmax理论上可自动关闭冗余专家，但其实际训练后是否仍保持稀疏性尚不明确。本文核心问题是：稀疏映射的理论能力能否在训练中持续体现，还是会被模型自适应调整所抵消？
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 研究在统一架构下训练了3亿和10亿参数的MoE语言模型，仅改变路由中的概率映射函数（softmax、1.5-entmax、sparsemax、normmax），其余结构、数据和平衡目标完全一致。输入为文本序列，输出为预测词元，路由根据隐藏状态打分并经映射生成权重，top-2选择专家组合输出。评估包括语言建模损失、下游任务准确率，以及路由行为如丢弃质量、参与专家数和负载均衡。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 论文发现稀疏映射的实际表现差异巨大且非由映射本身单独决定：1.5-entmax比softmax少丢弃30%概率质量却几乎从不减少专家数，normmax则使21%的token仅用一个专家。关键结论是，专家参与由映射的零值阈值与训练所得分数分布共同决定，而非单纯依赖映射的稀疏能力。这揭示了路由器会自适应调整分数尺度以配合映射特性。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: 作者通过记录训练后的路由器分数，分析其与各映射零值阈值的关系来解构参与机制。例如，1.5-entmax需top-2分数差达2才置零，而训练使其分数差距远低于此；sparsemax与normmax虽共享阈值1，但因学习到不同差距分布而导致参与率显著不同。该方法建立了‘分数分布-映射阈值’联合分析框架，解释了为何相同top-K结构下稀疏行为迥异。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 实验基于单一训练种子和特定平衡目标，小质量差异不足以排序映射优劣；且未测量跳过零权专家的实际计算节省。然而，论文清晰揭示了路由中分数尺度的学习机制及其对推理鲁棒性的影响——稀疏映射极大降低了增加推理专家数时的性能下降。最值得读的是其对路由机制的深度诊断与‘联合适应’观点，挑战了简单替换映射的设计思路。

papers.title: What Matters for Latent Reasoning with Flow Matching
papers.titleZh: 基于流匹配的潜在推理关键因素
papers.abstract: Latent reasoning lets a large language model (LLM) think in a continuous space and verbalize only the answer. We argue that an effective latent thought must meet five requirements: it should be useful, helping produce the correct answer rather than merely changing it, diverse, so that resampling yields different reasoning trajectories, explainable, so that a decoded chain of thought (CoT) reflects reasoning the answer actually follows, refinable with more inference compute, and efficient, costing less than an explicit CoT at comparable accuracy. Current methods rarely meet these requirements: they learn shortcuts from the question, distill the explicit CoT into their weights, or imitate it one token at a time. We focus on flow matching in a learned latent space, the family we argue is best placed to meet them, and identify the training choices that make it work. The result is Flow-based Latent Reasoning (FLaRe), a simple recipe covering what the latent space encodes and how to shape it, where to train the flow, how to read out the answer, and a final stage of training on the model's own verified thoughts. A probe for each requirement shows that FLaRe improves on prior latent methods in all five. It also compares favorably with them on arithmetic benchmarks, while reaching 97% of the accuracy of explicit CoT at a quarter of its latency.

summarySections.backgroundAndQuestion: 现有大语言模型依赖显式思维链进行推理，逐token生成中间步骤导致计算冗余、路径固化且成本随长度增长。潜在推理试图在连续空间中隐式完成思考，仅输出答案，但多数方法未能真正利用潜变量进行有效推理，常退化为从问题直接映射答案或复制训练数据，缺乏多样性、可解释性和扩展性。
summarySections.modelAndSetup: 论文研究在连续潜空间中通过流匹配进行推理的任务。输入是数学应用题，输出是答案及可解码的思维过程。模型由变分自编码器压缩思维链至潜码，流模型从噪声生成潜变量，再解码为答案。评估采用算术基准，对比显式思维链与多种潜在推理方法，在准确率、多样性、可解释性、可精炼性和延迟方面进行系统测试。
summarySections.contributionsAndResults: 提出FLaRe方法，首次使潜变量推理在五个核心维度全面超越先前方法。其思维既实用又多样，解码后反映真实推理路径，可通过增加计算步数提升，并在达到显式思维链97%准确率的同时将延迟降低至四分之一。这表明精心设计的流匹配框架能有效实现高质量、高效率的隐式推理。
summarySections.methodsAndTechniques: 关键在于训练设计：变分自编码器使用符号化思维链并施加输入与潜层扰动，确保潜空间平滑；流模型主要在噪声端训练，答案读取器同时学习处理预测与带噪潜码；最终阶段通过自训练机制，将模型自身验证正确的推理轨迹作为监督信号，反向传播答案损失以端到端优化整个推理链。
summarySections.limitationsAndReadingValue: 方法依赖符号化思维链转换，对非结构化推理任务泛化性未知；自训练需额外问题池，且潜空间容量固定。尽管如此，其对潜在推理五大需求的定义与验证极具启发性，最值得阅读的是问题设定、消融分析与探针设计，为后续研究提供了清晰框架与评测标准。
